description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The resource describes the Lake Wheeler testbed scene for Sionna ray tracing. AERPAW directs users to the scene export in its digital-twin Sionna-extension repository. The repository README describes lake-wheeler-scene.xml and referenced meshes, with an interface to the AERPAW channel emulator. A later GPU example defaults to a built-in Munich scene, so selecting the Lake Wheeler scene must be checked explicitly. The geometry files themselves were not inspected. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. Access links are supplied on the provider landing page. Licence, cost and access requirements remain uncertain for the linked release. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Lake Wheeler wireless ray-tracing geometry. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
